body:
sarah_support: FYI — customer acct acct_9XH reports their promo credits expired but the dashboard still shows 12,000 remaining and they were invoiced for overage. Customer says this started after two promos overlapped last month. Can we triage?

amy_support: which account & invoice? any screenshots from the customer?

sarah_support: acct_9XH (org: Acme Widgets). Invoice INV-2026-0319. Customer sent a screenshot of billing > invoice line items, and a CSV export from the usage page showing tokens and 'credits_applied'. I'll paste their CSV in the ticket. They say credits were applied out-of-order (old promo burned before recent one).

billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2026-0319 processed 2026-03-14 08:12 UTC. Promo codes attached: promo_free_202601 (expires 2026-03-01), partnership_promo_202603 (expires 2026-04-01).

raj_billing: I'll take a first pass. Earliest suspicion: ledger burn-order logic may be using LIFO for staged promos in the new proration job we shipped last week. If LIFO is used the older promo could be consumed first if flags are inconsistent. Can you share the CSV?

amy_support: Pasted CSV (redacted) into ticket thread. Quick snippet in-line: 

```
account,ts,tokens,credits_applied
acct_9XH,2026-03-02,12000,"partnership_promo_202603"
acct_9XH,2026-03-03,8000,"promo_free_202601"
```

marco_eng: I cloned a repro locally against staging and can reproduce behavior. Repro steps:
1) create two overlapping promos: promo_old with start=2026-01-01 end=2026-03-01, promo_new start=2026-02-15 end=2026-04-01
2) run metering worker `metering-worker apply-usage --account acct_test --batch 2026-03-01`
3) check `credit_ledger` ordering with: 
```
SELECT id, promo_code, status, created_at FROM credit_ledger WHERE account_id='acct_test' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Observed: credits with status `staged` were prioritized before `active` in the burn pass due to an accidental sort on `created_at DESC`. That makes the older promo get consumed first when both are present.

raj_billing: confirms. The intent is FIFO by promo start date (oldest first) for promos; free-trial should be used after promotional partner credits per policy, but our edge-case rule was reversed.

jen_ops: Mitigation options:
- Immediate customer remediation: issue compensating credits equal to the mis-applied amount (we can mint 12k token credits now).
- Billing fix: create an invoice credit for INV-2026-0319 and mark as pending adjustment; follow with PR to update ledger and re-run reconcile for affected accounts.
- Hotfix: patch metering-worker to sort by `promo_priority` then `start_date` rather than created_at, deploy to staging then prod.

marco_eng: I can ship a hotfix branch: change `sort_by` in `applyCredits()` from `created_at DESC` to `COALESCE(promo_priority,0) ASC, start_date ASC, created_at ASC`. Unit tests added. Planning canary deploy to prod batch service at 11:00 UTC after smoke tests.

raj_billing: For customer communication: recommend issuing 12,000 token credits and offering to waive the invoiced overage (or apply invoice credit). Legal/account may want approval if invoice > $5k. I'll prepare the invoice adjustment doc.

amy_support: I'll draft the customer message: "Thanks — we identified a bug where overlapping promos were burned in the wrong order. We're issuing 12,000 usage credits to your account immediately and we'll apply an invoice credit to INV-2026-0319. Sorry for the confusion, ETA 24 hrs for credits and 3 business days for invoice adjustment." Will send once billing confirms. :pray:

raj_billing: Action items: [1] marco to open PR and schedule canary (owner: marco_eng). [2] jen to create invoice credit and hold refund approval (owner: jen_ops). [3] amy to send customer message after billing OK (owner: amy_support). [4] billing to run a reconciliation job to find other accounts affected between 2026-02-14 and 2026-03-05 (owner: raj_billing).

billing-bot: Note: Reconciliation job queued (job_id: recon-2026-0314-77). Estimated runtime: 2h.

marco_eng: PR opened: GH#redwood/metering 482 - fix burn order; added unit & integration tests. Canary scheduled. Will monitor recon job and rollback if we see divergence metrics.

amy_support: customer updated: "Appreciate the quick response. Please keep us posted on the invoice credit."

sarah_support: closing loop here — created internal incident ticket INC-2026-0314-09 and linked this thread. Will update when recon job completes.

raj_billing: recon finished — found 14 accounts with similar pattern. jen_ops please proceed with invoice credits where threshold met, otherwise issue usage credits. I'll prepare summary report to share with CS and Finance.

jen_ops: Done — invoice credits queued for 5 accounts, usage credits issued for the rest. Notifying account owners.

marco_eng: Canary looks good; hotfix promoted to prod. Leaving metrics alert on for 48hrs.

amy_support: Thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved — customer notified and credits applied.
